findings.subject: Eight Pool kinds versus domain attachments
findings.finding: The implementation has Unit, Symbol, Entity, Part, Package, Footprint, Padstack and PinPadMap. ModelAttachment is separately governed data associated with targets; do not lose Unit/Entity by copying the older seven-DomainObject list or invent ParametricPackage as a ninth adopted kind.

findings.subject: Separate physical and electrical authority
findings.finding: Units define electrical pins; Symbols their graphic presentation; Entities their gates; Parts orderable identity/options; Packages bodies/terminals; Footprints land/process geometry; Padstacks layer/drill/aperture definitions; maps bind gate-qualified pins and physical pad references. Name matching and legacy Package.pads/Part.pad_map do not become target authority.

findings.subject: Standards and process basis
findings.finding: Owner-directed standards references ANSI Y32.2-1975(reaffirmed1989), IPC-7351B and ISO10303-21 must appear with version/source/applicability and unknown coverage. Storing an assertion or model format is not standards certification. Copper, mask and paste require independently inspectable actual geometry and declared process basis; no universal expansion/reduction or peer-majority repair rule is selected.

findings.subject: Source fidelity versus qualification
findings.finding: Original file provenance, import identity/trace, conversion support/loss, native binding validity, object review/approval, standards basis and production qualification are distinct dimensions. Existing synthetic/native fixture proof is behavior evidence, not approved manufacturer seed or provider conversion fidelity.

findings.subject: Research not product authority
findings.finding: Parametric types, DXF profiles, round-trip promises, adoption timelines, license claims and estimated solver performance/effort in research remain proposals. They do not authorize dependencies, new pool schemas, production thresholds, publication or runtime successor.

findings.subject: Known contract reconciliation
findings.finding: Library Authoring still proposes NEW library_author.rs/CLI JSON constructors while S01 identified existing engine api/native_write builders. Pool duplicate/shadow policy, validation tiers, retained graph update and model/process systematic consumption remain unresolved; no GUI-private writer or automatic update is justified.

findings.subject: Auditor current-versus-target bounds
findings.finding: Manager-relayed audit: eight Pool kinds lack uniform approval/provenance fields; absent metadata must remain unavailable and Part lifecycle is separate from approval. Symbol bound_with_part does not prove complete physical mapping. Current write validation is shape/path/UUID plus separate CLI/graph checks, not universal final-graph or manufacturer qualification. Circle/Rect apertures and Inherit mask/paste have fidelity gaps. Frozen physical-pad journal history does not prove general retained old/new library graph or complete affected-placement update/approve/apply GUI.

Full browser, ordinary eight-kind authoring, retained old/new graph update, systematic model/process consumption and approved seed remain unproved. No build/import/replay was performed.
